verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own GraphQL API lets users retrieve their transcripts and transcript details in a structured format, and Super Admins can query all data in a team's account. That gives a programmatic route to getting data out, but there is no documented export feature, no named open file formats, and no exit or deletion path. missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/text/audio files), coverage of all data types such as recordings, summaries and soundbites, documented account offboarding or deletion, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This API allows you to retrieve exactly the data you need in a structured format.
The Fireflies API is built on top of GraphQL, a powerful interface designed to provide you with efficient and flexible access to your data.
The transcripts query is designed to fetch a list of transcripts against input arguments.
The Super Admin functionality allows you to bypass your team's privacy settings, allowing you to query all data in your team's account.
